2607.17757.title: Seg2Grasp: A Robust Modular Suction Grasping in Bin Picking
2607.17757.paper_summary: Current bin picking methods that rely heavily on end-to-end learning often falter when confronted with unfamiliar or complex objects in unstructured environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Seg2Grasp, a modular pipeline designed for robust suction grasping in dynamic and cluttered bin scenarios. Seg2Grasp is built on a three-step process: Segmentation, Grasping, and Classification. The Segmentation module employs a Transformer-based model to generate class-agnostic object masks from RGB-D images, ensuring accurate detection across various conditions. The Grasping module uses surface normals and mask proposals to determine the optimal suction points, enhancing grasp success. Finally, the Classification module leverages fine-tuned open-vocabulary Mask-CLIP for precise object identification, enabling versatile handling of diverse objects. Real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that Seg2Grasp outperforms existing methods in success rates and adaptability, establishing it as a powerful tool for automated bin picking in industrial settings.
2607.17757.paper_summary_zh: 目前依賴端到端學習的箱子撿取方法在面對不熟悉或複雜物體於非結構化環境時常常會失敗。為了克服這些限制，我們介紹了Seg2Grasp，一個設計用於在動態和雜亂的箱子場景中進行穩健吸取抓取的模組化流程。Seg2Grasp建立在三個步驟之上：分割、抓取和分類。分割模組採用基於Transformer的模型，從RGB-D影像生成與類別無關的物體掩膜，確保在各種條件下的準確檢測。抓取模組利用表面法線和掩膜提議來確定最佳吸取點，提升抓取成功率。最後，分類模組利用微調的開放詞彙Mask-CLIP進行精確的物體識別，使其能夠靈活處理各種物體。實際的機器人實驗顯示，Seg2Grasp在成功率和適應性方面超越了現有方法，確立了其作為工業環境中自動化箱子撿取的強大工具。
